name: AutoLayout
description: Generates complete, playable layouts from a song, verified by a physics bot.

open-autolayout.name: Open AutoLayout
open-autolayout.description: Opens the AutoLayout popup in the editor.

record-toggle.name: Start / stop click recording
record-toggle.description: Toggles the click recorder while playing a level.

backup-before-apply.name: Back up before applying
backup-before-apply.description: Saves the current level string to the mod's save folder before AutoLayout changes the level.

analysis-threads.name: Worker threads
analysis-threads.description: Threads used for generating variants in parallel (0 = automatic).
